principal_reference.use: Principal appearance target; comparison only, no copied art or engine capability claim

comparison_regions.observation: The first imported-asset candidate was rejected by the user because the person was not recognizable. The revised knight uses an upright source idle pose, 1.8 display scale, a higher focus point, brighter sky/ambient and frontal fill. Source torso/cape PBR textures transfer through simple export materials to fix black albedo. Judge head, torso, separate arms and two legs at native zoom x1; this candidate still needs human review.

The imported timber barrel is a single simple prop beside the detailed knight and a small peasant hut. Its staves, rim and round mass read at zoom x1. The hut has more texture density than the initial dummy corner; it establishes realistic material/architecture inputs without starting asset-volume production.

Imported boots, barrel, tree trunk and hut foundation meet the plain ground receiver with directional shadows. The hut overlaps the ground and supports wall/roof depth comparison. AO/contact-depth candidates, water and final composition remain later tests; shadow-only depth is not a completed contact-depth effect.

Source foliage, thatch/timber and barrel textures retain the muted environment palette. The revised knight has frontal fill and brighter ambient/sky reflections to expose armor forms. These are declared prototype lighting changes; final stylized value separation and outline/highlight decisions remain T05.

proposed_bounds.bound: At normal zoom x1, the reviewer must immediately recognize a human figure with a head, torso, two arms and two distinct legs/boots; armor and cloak accents should remain distinguishable from the ground and hut. Enlarged crops or zoom x2 do not establish this bound.

Retain 384x216 and orthographic height 9/4.5. Prototype display scales: knight 1.8, hut 0.5, tree 0.35, barrel 1.0; camera focus height 1.3m keeps the enlarged character within both views. These composition proportions need explicit acceptance and do not define production gameplay dimensions.

Knight silhouette remains separable from ground, hut and foliage in all three lighting states; boots and building foundations meet the ground, architecture depth is visible, amber light does not erase armor/cape separation.

T04/T09 must show no stationary pixel changes, no repeated crawl/shimmer on rigid edges during slow/diagonal tracking, no one-frame silhouette disappearance or outline-width pumping. One internal-pixel silhouette lines and selective convex highlights are reviewed in T05. No motion pass is claimed in T03.
No filled-surface outlines, stale reflection/depth frames, actor disappearance or unauthorized information in later combined cases; fallback deviations need explicit review.
